common.font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
common.store_url_note: store_url: the storefront address used by the logo, shop and footer links.
common.paste_hint: ENGLISH copy. If English is your store's default language: open the notification, click "Edit code" and replace everything in "Email body (HTML)". If Arabic is the default, paste this into the English translation via "Localize" instead (see README).
common.you_saved: You saved {{ lx_savings | money }} on this order.
common.taxes_included_note: Includes {{ tax_price | money }} in taxes.
common.payment_pending: Payment isn't complete yet. Paying cash on delivery? Please have {{ total_price | money }} ready for the courier.
common.no_tracking: Tracking details aren't available for this shipment yet. You can still follow your order with the button below.
common.help_body_wa: Reply to this email or message us on WhatsApp and we'll get back to you.
common.help_body_mail: Just reply to this email and our team will get back to you.
common.wa_checkout: Hi LINUX, I have a question about my bag:
common.wa_account: Hi LINUX, I have a question about my account:
common.footer_order: You're receiving this email because you placed an order with LINUX.
common.footer_checkout: You're receiving this email because you started a checkout with LINUX.
common.footer_account: You're receiving this email because of activity on your LINUX account.
common.link_fallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser:
common.custom_title: Your custom piece is in the studio
common.custom_body: We review every design before it goes on the machine. If anything needs a tweak, we'll contact you before printing or embroidery.

order_confirmation.subject: Order {{ name }} confirmed. Thank you!
order_confirmation.preheader: We've got your order and we're getting your pieces ready.
order_confirmation.title: Order {{ name }} confirmed
order_confirmation.h1: Thanks{% if lx_first_name != blank %}, {{ lx_first_name | escape }}{% endif %}. Your order is in.
order_confirmation.body: We're getting your pieces ready. As soon as your order ships, you'll get another email with the tracking details.

shipping_confirmation.subject: Order {{ name }} is on its way
shipping_confirmation.preheader: Your LINUX order has shipped. Track it anytime.
shipping_confirmation.title: Order {{ name }} is on its way
shipping_confirmation.h1: Your order is on its way.
shipping_confirmation.h1_partial: Part of your order is on its way.
shipping_confirmation.h1_last: The rest of your order is on its way.
shipping_confirmation.body_full: Good news{% if lx_first_name != blank %}, {{ lx_first_name | escape }}{% endif %}! Your order has left our studio. Follow it with the tracking details below.
shipping_confirmation.body_last: The last pieces from your order have left our studio. Follow them with the tracking details below.
shipping_confirmation.body_partial: Part of your order has left our studio. The rest will follow in a separate shipment, and we'll email you when it's on the way.

shipping_update.subject: Tracking update for order {{ name }}
shipping_update.preheader: The tracking details for your LINUX order have changed.
shipping_update.title: Tracking update for order {{ name }}
shipping_update.body: We've updated the shipping details for your order. Please use the new tracking information below.

out_for_delivery.subject: Order {{ name }} is out for delivery
out_for_delivery.preheader: Your LINUX order is out for delivery. Keep your phone nearby.
out_for_delivery.title: Order {{ name }} is out for delivery
out_for_delivery.body: Your order is out for delivery. Keep your phone nearby: the courier may call before arriving.
out_for_delivery.cod_note: Paying cash on delivery? Please have {{ total_price | money }} ready.

delivered.subject: Order {{ name }} has been delivered
delivered.preheader: Your pieces have arrived. Wear them well.
delivered.title: Order {{ name }} has been delivered
delivered.body: Your order has been delivered{% if lx_first_name != blank %}, {{ lx_first_name | escape }}{% endif %}. Size not right? You can exchange unworn pieces within 14 days: just reply to this email.
delivered.not_received: Didn't get it? Reply to this email and we'll check with the courier right away.

order_cancelled.subject: Order {{ name }} has been cancelled
order_cancelled.preheader: Your LINUX order was cancelled. Here are the details.
order_cancelled.title: Order {{ name }} has been cancelled
order_cancelled.reason_customer: As you requested, we've cancelled order {{ name }}.
order_cancelled.reason_inventory: We're really sorry: some pieces sold out before we could prepare your order, so we had to cancel order {{ name }}.
order_cancelled.reason_declined: Your payment was declined, so order {{ name }} was cancelled.
order_cancelled.reason_other: Order {{ name }} has been cancelled. If you weren't expecting this, reply to this email and we'll sort it out.
order_cancelled.refund_refunded: Your refund has been issued to your original payment method. Depending on your bank, it can take a few business days to appear.
order_cancelled.refund_voided: The payment authorization has been released, so you won't be charged.
order_cancelled.refund_pending: No payment was collected for this order.
order_cancelled.refund_paid: If you've already paid, we'll refund you to your original payment method.

abandoned_checkout.subject: You left something in your bag
abandoned_checkout.preheader: Your bag is saved. Pick up right where you left off.
abandoned_checkout.title: You left something in your bag
abandoned_checkout.h1: You left something in your bag.
abandoned_checkout.body: No rush{% if lx_first_name != blank %}, {{ lx_first_name | escape }}{% endif %}. We saved your pieces, but sizes and colours can sell out, so finish your order whenever you're ready.

customer_account_invite.subject: Activate your LINUX account
customer_account_invite.preheader: Set a password to track orders and check out faster.
customer_account_invite.title: Activate your LINUX account
customer_account_invite.body: Hi{% if customer.first_name != blank %} {{ customer.first_name | escape }}{% endif %}, you've been invited to create an account with us. Set a password to track your orders, save your addresses and check out faster.
customer_account_invite.ignore: Weren't expecting this invitation? You can safely ignore this email.

customer_account_welcome.subject: Welcome to LINUX
customer_account_welcome.preheader: Your account is active. Here's what's waiting for you.
customer_account_welcome.title: Welcome to LINUX
customer_account_welcome.h1: Welcome to LINUX{% if customer.first_name != blank %}, {{ customer.first_name | escape }}{% endif %}.
customer_account_welcome.body: Your account is active. Next time you shop, sign in to check out faster and follow every order in one place.

customer_password_reset.subject: Reset your LINUX password
customer_password_reset.preheader: Use this link to choose a new password.
customer_password_reset.title: Reset your LINUX password
customer_password_reset.body: Tap the button below to choose a new password for your LINUX account.
customer_password_reset.ignore: Didn't ask for this? You can safely ignore this email. Your password won't change.
